settings.title: Settings
settings.baseUrlHelp: The default points to Ollama on your PC: free and keyless.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Stays on your computer only. Leave empty for local models.
settings.showOriginal: Show the original text above the translation
settings.previewOriginal: 橋が落ちている。別の道を探すしかない。
settings.previewText: The bridge is out. You'll have to find another way across.

pages.title: Run the game in a window
pages.text: Subquest reads the game screen. Use windowed or borderless mode in the game's video options; exclusive fullscreen blocks capture.

pages.title: Pick the game
pages.text: In Play, choose the game window from the list. If it isn't there, make sure it isn't minimized and refresh the list.

pages.title: Show where the dialogue is
pages.text: If the game uses a dialogue box, mark just that area: Subquest gets faster and makes fewer mistakes. For menus and signs, use the whole screen.

pages.title: Pick who translates
pages.text: In Settings, choose the service. A local model through Ollama is free and works offline; cloud services need an API key and usually translate better.

pages.title: Play
pages.text: The translation shows up over the game without stealing focus. Each game gets a profile with its area and glossary, so next time it starts ready.

errors.coreMissing: Core not found. Build the core folder and reopen Subquest.
errors.invalidArg: Something wrong was sent to the core. Try again; if it repeats, report the issue.
errors.alreadyRunning: A translation is already running. Stop it before starting another.
errors.platform: Windows refused to capture this window. Make sure the game is open, windowed or borderless, and not minimized.
errors.notImplemented: This part is still being built. It arrives in the next steps of phase 1.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Details are in the console (F12).
